posts.name: Tamilvanan P
posts.cooked:
Hi All,

I missed to attend SCT window 1 (Sep25 to Sep29) accidentally and i was expecting SCT window 2. But now in dashboard I could see Absent for both OPPE and SCT . I have already done OPPE for python in my foundation itself with all suitable configuration.

Here i missed SCT alone and waiting for window 2 . But OPPE is mentioned as absent and do i need to pay for this attending OPPE again in next term? What i need to do next?

image1170×1587 201 KB

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked: No, OPPE is not marked absent. That word “OPPE & SCT” approval means that you missed taking SCT. For second slot dates, if any, mail to support.

posts.name: Ishan Shishodiya
posts.cooked:
My SCT Window-1 submission was rejected. Will there be Google Meet rooms made for SCT Window-2 similar to Window-1 or would we have to do that by ourselves?

I also wanted to clarify the steps for the SCT -

  1. Proper positioning of camera, both the student and their computer screen should be visible.
  2. Join the Google Meet from the phone as well as the PC, and take a screenshot of your setup.
  3. Upload this screenshot in the SCT Window-2 form.
  4. Visit the exam portal and submit it.

Is that it or am I missing something?

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked: Please don’t create posts before checking if a posts already exists. The SCT related things needs to be mailed to support. SCT-2 will be the same as SCT-1
